coverage_exempt.reason: The loader installs original actor vtable 0x5137f0 and uses its concrete 0x4c9d40 -> 0x4c7df0 -> 0x4c8160 initializer. Success has already dereferenced the distinct allocated logic object and reloaded actor+0x6c; none of these functions changes that pointer and no user callback executes. Therefore successful initialization followed immediately by a null actor+0x6c is unreachable in this ordinary synchronous allocation domain. Keep the defensive cleanup body translated; do not replace the pinned game initializer with a fixture to reach it.

limits: operator new is a deterministic allocator fixture, including the actor, logic and CString blocks.
operator delete is a release fixture; original game and CString destructors still execute.
lstrlenA is a Windows fixture returning the actual byte length of its argument.
InterlockedDecrement is a Windows fixture updating and returning the pointed reference count.
The declared integration metadata describes the preserved legacy WorldObjectRuntime API; the canonical entry is not yet wired into the native app.

Cases use ordinary high-address CString buffers and single-byte CRT comparison mode; string-resource loading, multibyte locale locks and guest exception unwinding are outside this canonical entry domain.
notes: Full legacy loader and actor constructor surface plus ten reviewed actor services. Sources/WorldObjectRuntime.cpp and .h remain for existing app callers. The new first source is the independent canonical module. Original CString, CMap, resource selection, concrete actor destructors and collection helpers remain original-backed; no game callee fixtures are declared.
